DELETE dbo.cur_items; INSERT dbo.cur_items(id,name,qty) VALUES(1,'a',10),(2,'b',20),(3,'c',30),(4,'d',40),(5,'e',50) /*fill items*/

OPEN c_default; SELECT @@CURSOR_ROWS AS cursor_rows, CURSOR_STATUS('global','c_default') AS global_status; FETCH NEXT FROM c_default; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*1*/; FETCH c_default; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*2*/; SELECT name, properties, is_open FROM sys.dm_exec_cursors(@@SPID) ORDER BY name /*default open fetch without into*/
FETCH PRIOR FROM c_default; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*1*/ /*default prior rejected*/
FETCH NEXT FROM c_default; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*1*/; FETCH NEXT FROM c_default; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*2*/ /*default fetch past end*/
CLOSE c_default; SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','c_default') AS global_status, @@CURSOR_ROWS AS cursor_rows, @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*default close*/
FETCH NEXT FROM c_default; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*1*/ /*default fetch closed*/
CLOSE c_default /*default close closed*/
OPEN c_default; FETCH NEXT FROM c_default; SELECT @@CURSOR_ROWS AS cursor_rows; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*1*/ /*default reopen*/
OPEN c_default; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status /*1*/ /*default open open*/

DEALLOCATE c_default; SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','c_default') AS global_status, @@CURSOR_ROWS AS cursor_rows, @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status; SELECT name, properties, is_open FROM sys.dm_exec_cursors(@@SPID) ORDER BY name /*default deallocate open*/
FETCH NEXT FROM c_default /*default fetch deallocated*/
DEALLOCATE c_default /*default deallocate missing*/
OPEN c_default /*default open missing*/
DECLARE c_dup CURSOR GLOBAL FOR SELECT 1 AS one; DECLARE c_dup CURSOR GLOBAL FOR SELECT 2 AS two; SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','c_dup') AS global_status /*duplicate declare*/

DECLARE c_mismatch CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT id, name FROM dbo.cur_items ORDER BY id; DECLARE @id INT = -1; OPEN c_mismatch; FETCH NEXT FROM c_mismatch INTO @id; SELECT @@FETCH_STATUS AS fetch_status, @id AS id, CURSOR_STATUS('local','c_mismatch') AS local_status /*into count mismatch*/
